functions.arguments: _attempt_id uuid, _claim_id uuid, _period_id uuid, _file_name text, _mime_type text, _size_bytes integer, _sha256 text
functions.identityArguments: _attempt_id uuid, _claim_id uuid, _period_id uuid, _file_name text, _mime_type text, _size_bytes integer, _sha256 text

functions.actualProsrc:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',_attempt.id,'claimId',_attempt.claim_id,'periodId',_attempt.period_id,
  'storagePath',_attempt.storage_path,'fileName',_attempt.file_name,'mimeType',_attempt.mime_type,
  'sizeBytes',_attempt.size_bytes,'sha256',_attempt.sha256,'status',_attempt.status,
  'revision',_attempt.revision,'createdAt',_attempt.created_at,'updatedAt',_attempt.updated_at,
  'evidence', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'claimId',e.claim_id,'periodId',e.period_id,
    'fileName',e.file_name,'mimeType',e.mime_type,'sizeBytes',e.size_bytes,
    'uploadedAt',e.uploaded_at,'lifecycleState',e.lifecycle_state)
    FROM public.sp_evidence e WHERE e.id=_attempt.evidence_id AND e.holder_user_id=_attempt.holder_user_id
      AND e.storage_path=_attempt.storage_path))

    WHEN 'image/png'::text THEN 'png'::text

constraints.review: storage_path is the sole unique key.

constraints.name: sp_evidence_upload_attempts_file_name_check
constraints.review: Inclusive length1..300; PostgreSQL BETWEEN expands to >=1 AND <=300.

constraints.name: sp_evidence_upload_attempts_mime_type_check
constraints.review: Exactly application/pdf,image/jpeg,image/png,image/heic; IN expands to =ANY of the same four text literals.

constraints.name: sp_evidence_upload_attempts_check
constraints.review: Exactly one claim_id/period_id is non-null; boolean inequality of the same null tests.
